rows.notes: Discovery add (T051, Americas sweep). Cancelled project, kept for completeness; contributes 0 to active aggregates. ESS News (2025-02-04): KORE said plans for the KOREPlex in Buckeye, AZ 'will not move forward at this time' and the site is for sale (S01). Planned scope: NMC and LFP cells (S04), 'initial 6 GWh' with full operation set for 2025 (S02); the company's earlier public plan was 12 GWh (series of 2021-23 press and a Renewable Energy World item of 2025-02-04 seen via fetch summary, quote not captured) - not used as nameplate because no verbatim source captured, so nameplate 6 = stated initial phase only; ref_year 2025 = year full operation was set (S02). Status under_construction (D-020) because a local report cited by ESS News says as much as USD 10m of site work was done (S03); no building construction evidenced. Not found: any revival or confirmed site sale after Feb 2025. DOE USD 850m loan was never closed (search snippet only, not cited). Cell format and end market not stated on opened pages -> null (company is an ESS/EV cell developer). Coordinates not located -> null.

fields.plant_name: FREYR Giga America (Coweta County, Georgia; Bridgeport Industrial Park)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T051, Americas sweep). Cancelled project kept for completeness; contributes 0 to active aggregates. Announced 2022-11-11 by the Georgia governor: first phase ~34 GWh at Bridgeport Industrial Park, Coweta County (S05); POWER Engineering (S06) confirms ~34 GWh first-phase cell module (24M SemiSolid platform) and mentions a possible total investment of USD 2.6bn through 2029 with no total GWh figure -> nameplate 34 = first phase only; ref_year 2022 = publication-year fallback, searched (no phase dates). Status announced (D-020): site acquired, but no construction works evidenced. Cancelled: FREYR notified Coweta County in Jan 2025 and Electrek (2025-02-10) cites 'realignment of near-term strategic goals' (S07) after its pivot to US solar; site sale for USD 50m reported in the same article. Parent T1 Energy is FREYR's renamed successor (existing DB row freyr-battery-freyr-giga-arctic-mo-i-rana-norway lists parent T1 Energy); the T1 link was not itself checked on an opened page. Overlaps conceptually with the 2021 FREYR-Koch 50 GWh JV concept (search snippets only) - not a separate site. Chemistry/format/end market left null (24M semi-solid; later ESS focus seen only in search snippets). Coordinates not located -> null.

fields.plant_name: Natron Energy Edgecombe County gigafactory (North Carolina)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T051, Americas sweep). Cancelled project kept for completeness; contributes 0 to active aggregates. Announced 2024-08-15/16: USD ~1.4bn sodium-ion factory in Edgecombe County NC (also called Rocky Mount / Kingsboro megasite in other press; separate site from the existing Natron Holland MI row, whose notes only mention the halted NC project). Capacity: pv magazine says 'will produce 24 GW of Natron's sodium-ion batteries annually' (S08) - the page uses GW only; other outlets (search snippets) alternate between 24 GW and 24 GWh and Natron's product is power-oriented, so units are unresolved and nameplate/ref_year are left null (D-026 spirit; figure not confirmed as GWh/yr of cells). Status announced: described as 'planned', no construction start or timeline on opened page. Cancelled: Natron discontinued operations on 2025-09-03 'because of financing challenges' (S09) and the NC factory was cancelled per NC Commerce Secretary (S10). Cell format / end market not stated on opened pages -> null. Coordinates not located -> null.
